title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
We're seeking an exceptional Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our rapidly growing engineering team. You'll be instrumental in designing and building scalable web applications that serve millions of users worldwide.

As a key member of our team, you'll work on challenging problems including real-time data processing, microservices architecture, and building intuitive user interfaces. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to deliver features that delight our customers.

You'll have the opportunity to mentor junior developers, participate in architectural decisions, and contribute to our engineering culture. We value innovation, code quality, and continuous learning.
shortDescription: Join our team to build scalable web applications using React, Node.js, and cutting-edge technologies.
requirements: 6+ years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with React and modern frontend frameworks
Extensive backend development experience with Node.js
Deep understanding of database design and optimization
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Latest MacBook Pro and equipment stipend
Annual company retreat to exotic locations

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and machine learning? We're looking for a talented ML Engineer to help us build the next generation of intelligent systems.

You'll work on exciting projects including natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics. Our team is at the forefront of AI innovation, developing models that power features used by millions of users daily.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in machine learning theory, practical experience deploying models to production, and a passion for staying current with the latest research. You'll have access to significant computational resources and work alongside world-class researchers and engineers.
shortDescription: Build cutting-edge ML models and deploy them at scale using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and modern MLOps practices.
requirements: Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field
4+ years of experience in machine learning engineering
Proven track record of deploying ML models to production
benefits: Premium health insurance with zero employee cost
Hybrid work model (3 days office, 2 days remote)

title: DevOps Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We're seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team and help us scale our cloud platform. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure across multiple environments.

In this role, you'll work with cutting-edge technologies including Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. You'll collaborate with development teams to improve deployment processes, ensure high availability, and optimize infrastructure costs.

The ideal candidate is passionate about automation, has strong Linux skills, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging problems at scale and make a significant impact on our engineering productivity.
shortDescription: Architect and maintain cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern DevOps tools.
requirements: Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
Proficiency with AWS or other major cloud platforms
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Understanding of networking and security best practices
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

title: Mobile Developer - iOS/Android
description:
Join our mobile team to create beautiful, performant mobile applications that millions of users love. We're looking for an experienced mobile developer who can work across both iOS and Android platforms.

You'll be responsible for building new features, improving app performance, and ensuring a seamless user experience. Our mobile apps are critical to our business, and you'll have the opportunity to work on high-impact projects that directly affect user engagement and satisfaction.

We value clean code, thorough testing, and attention to detail. You'll collaborate with designers, backend engineers, and product managers to deliver polished mobile experiences.
shortDescription: Develop cross-platform mobile applications using React Native or native iOS/Android technologies.
requirements: Strong proficiency in Swift and/or Kotlin
Experience with React Native or Flutter
Deep understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices
Experience with RESTful APIs and mobile networking
Published apps on App Store and/or Google Play
benefits: Latest iPhone and Android devices for testing

title: Frontend Developer - React Specialist
description:
We're looking for a passionate Frontend Developer with deep React expertise to join our UI engineering team. You'll build responsive, accessible, and performant web applications that provide exceptional user experiences.

In this role, you'll work closely with designers to implement pixel-perfect interfaces, collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs, and optimize application performance. You'll have the opportunity to influence our component library, establish best practices, and mentor other developers.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, deep understanding of modern JavaScript, and experience building complex single-page applications. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and excited about staying current with the latest frontend technologies.
shortDescription: Build modern, responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, and cutting-edge frontend tools.
requirements: Experience with state management (Redux, MobX, etc.)
Proficiency in modern CSS and responsive design
benefits: Learning budget for courses and books

title: Data Engineer - Big Data Platform
description:
Join our data engineering team to build and maintain large-scale data infrastructure. We're looking for an experienced Data Engineer who can design robust data pipelines, optimize query performance, and ensure data quality across our platform.

You'll work with petabytes of data, building systems that power analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence applications. You'll use technologies like Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and modern data warehousing solutions.

The ideal candidate has strong programming skills, deep understanding of distributed systems, and experience with both batch and streaming data processing. You'll collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to enable data-driven decision making across the organization.
shortDescription: Design and build scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, and modern data engineering tools.
requirements: Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala
Expert SQL knowledge and database optimization skills
Experience with distributed data processing (Spark, Hadoop)
Master's degree in Computer Science or related field preferred
benefits: Downtown Chicago office with great amenities

title: Product Manager - Technical
description:
We're seeking an exceptional Technical Product Manager to drive the vision and execution of our core products. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business, and user experience to deliver products that customers love.

In this role, you'll define product strategy, prioritize features, and collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders. You'll use data and customer feedback to make informed decisions and ensure we're building the right things at the right time.

The ideal candidate has a technical background, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication abilities. You should be comfortable diving into technical details while also thinking strategically about business impact and user needs.
shortDescription: Lead product strategy and execution for our core platform, working closely with engineering and design teams.
requirements: Technical background (CS degree or engineering experience)
Strong analytical and data-driven decision making skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven track record of shipping successful products
Experience with analytics tools and SQL

title: Backend Engineer - Golang
description:
We're looking for a talented Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) experience to join our platform team. You'll build high-performance, scalable backend services that power our application.

You'll work on microservices architecture, API design, database optimization, and distributed systems. Our backend handles millions of requests per day, and you'll have the opportunity to work on performance-critical systems that require careful design and optimization.

The ideal candidate is passionate about writing clean, efficient code and has experience building production systems at scale. You should be comfortable working independently, making technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
shortDescription: Build high-performance backend services and APIs using Golang, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture.
requirements: Experience with RESTful and/or gRPC APIs
Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

title: Security Engineer - Application Security
description:
Join our security team to protect our applications and infrastructure from evolving threats. We're seeking a Security Engineer specializing in application security to help us build secure systems from the ground up.

You'll conduct security assessments, perform code reviews, develop security tooling, and work with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities. You'll also contribute to our security training program and help establish security best practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate has both offensive and defensive security skills, strong programming abilities, and a passion for staying ahead of emerging threats. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging security problems and make a significant impact on our security posture.
shortDescription: Ensure application security through code reviews, penetration testing, and security tool development.
requirements: Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, Java)
Experience with security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP)
Understanding of cryptography and secure communication

title: UX/UI Designer - Product Design
description:
We're looking for a creative and user-focused Product Designer to join our design team. You'll be responsible for designing intuitive, beautiful interfaces that solve real user problems and delight our customers.

You'll work on the entire design process from user research and wireframing to high-fidelity mockups and prototypes. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers to bring ideas to life.

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design skills, deep understanding of user-centered design principles, and experience designing for web and mobile platforms. You should be comfortable presenting your work, receiving feedback, and iterating based on user insights.
shortDescription: Design exceptional user experiences for our web and mobile products using Figma and user-centered design principles.
requirements: Expert proficiency in Figma or similar design tools
Understanding of responsive and adaptive design
Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
We're seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of our production systems. You'll be responsible for maintaining high availability, monitoring system health, and responding to incidents.

You'll work on capacity planning, performance optimization, and building automation to reduce toil. You'll collaborate with development teams to improve system reliability and help them adopt SRE best practices.

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering skills, deep system administration knowledge, and experience running large-scale production systems. You should be comfortable being on-call and thrive under pressure when responding to incidents.
shortDescription: Ensure system reliability and performance through monitoring, automation, and incident response.
requirements: 5+ years of SRE or similar experience
Strong programming skills (Python, Go, or similar)
Proficiency with monitoring and alerting systems
Strong incident response and troubleshooting skills

title: QA Engineer - Automation
description:
Join our quality engineering team to ensure we deliver high-quality software to our users. We're looking for a QA Engineer with strong automation skills to build and maintain our test infrastructure.

You'll design and implement automated tests, develop testing frameworks, and work closely with developers to catch bugs early in the development cycle. You'll also help establish quality standards and best practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background, experience with modern testing frameworks, and a passion for software quality. You should be detail-oriented, have excellent problem-solving skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment.
shortDescription: Build automated test frameworks and ensure software quality using Selenium, Cypress, and modern testing tools.
requirements: Proficiency in at least one programming language

title: Engineering Manager - Platform Team
description:
We're seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our platform engineering team. You'll be responsible for building and mentoring a high-performing team while contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

You'll manage 6-8 engineers, conduct 1-on-1s, facilitate career development, and ensure the team delivers high-quality work on time. You'll also collaborate with product management and other engineering leaders to define roadmaps and priorities.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical background, proven people management experience, and excellent communication skills. You should be passionate about helping engineers grow their careers while maintaining technical excellence.
shortDescription: Lead and mentor a platform engineering team while contributing to technical strategy and architecture.
requirements: Strong technical background in backend/platform engineering
Proven track record of delivering complex projects
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

title: Data Scientist - Analytics
description:
We're looking for a talented Data Scientist to join our analytics team and help us make data-driven decisions. You'll analyze complex datasets, build predictive models, and communicate insights to stakeholders across the organization.

You'll work on a variety of projects including customer behavior analysis, churn prediction, recommendation systems, and A/B testing. You'll use statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and data visualization to uncover actionable insights.

The ideal candidate has strong statistical knowledge, programming skills, and the ability to translate complex analyses into clear business recommendations. You should be curious, analytical, and passionate about using data to solve problems.
shortDescription: Analyze data and build models to drive business decisions using Python, SQL, and statistical methods.
requirements: Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or related field
Strong programming skills in Python or R

title: Technical Writer - Developer Documentation
description:
We're seeking a talented Technical Writer to create comprehensive documentation for our developer platform. You'll work closely with engineers to document APIs, SDKs, and technical concepts in a clear, accessible manner.

You'll be responsible for writing tutorials, API references, guides, and code samples. You'll also improve our documentation processes and tools, ensuring our docs stay up-to-date and useful for developers.

The ideal candidate has technical writing experience, understanding of software development concepts, and the ability to explain complex topics simply. You should be detail-oriented, organized, and passionate about helping developers succeed.
shortDescription: Create clear, comprehensive developer documentation for APIs, SDKs, and technical platforms.
requirements: Strong understanding of software development concepts
Ability to write clear, concise technical content
Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication or related field

title: Solutions Architect - Enterprise
description:
We're looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to work with our enterprise customers, helping them design and implement solutions using our platform. You'll be the technical expert guiding customers through complex architectural decisions.

You'll conduct technical discovery sessions, create solution designs, provide best practices guidance, and work with our engineering team to address customer needs. You'll also contribute to reference architectures and technical content.

The ideal candidate has deep technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and experience working with enterprise customers. You should be comfortable presenting to technical and non-technical audiences and building trusted relationships with customers.
shortDescription: Guide enterprise customers through technical implementations and architectural decisions for our platform.
requirements: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience in pre-sales or customer-facing roles
Understanding of security and compliance requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

title: Blockchain Developer - Web3
description:
Join our Web3 team to build decentralized applications and smart contracts on blockchain platforms. We're looking for a talented Blockchain Developer with experience in Solidity and Ethereum development.

You'll design and implement smart contracts, build dApps, and integrate blockchain technology into our platform. You'll work on exciting projects in DeFi, NFTs, and decentralized identity.

The ideal candidate has strong programming skills, understanding of blockchain fundamentals, and experience deploying smart contracts to mainnet. You should be passionate about decentralization and the future of Web3.
shortDescription: Develop smart contracts and dApps using Solidity, Ethereum, and Web3 technologies.
requirements: Experience deploying smart contracts to mainnet
Experience with Web3 libraries and tools
benefits: Competitive salary and crypto token allocation

title: Junior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
We're looking for passionate Junior Software Engineers to join our growing engineering team. This is an excellent opportunity for early-career developers to learn from experienced engineers and work on real-world projects.

You'll work on both frontend and backend tasks, participate in code reviews, and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow. You'll receive mentorship from senior engineers and have opportunities to work with modern technologies and best practices.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, some practical experience (through internships, bootcamps, or personal projects), and eagerness to learn. We value curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and good communication skills.
shortDescription: Start your career building web applications with mentorship from experienced engineers.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent bootcamp/self-taught experience
Understanding of JavaScript and web fundamentals
Basic knowledge of React or similar framework
Familiarity with Git and version control
Portfolio or GitHub profile showcasing personal projects
benefits: Learning budget for courses and books

title: Staff Engineer - Distinguished Technical Leader
description:
We're seeking an exceptional Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership across our engineering organization. You'll work on the most complex technical challenges, drive architectural decisions, and mentor engineers at all levels.

You'll influence technical strategy, establish best practices, and serve as a technical authority across multiple teams. You'll tackle problems that require deep technical expertise and have significant business impact.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience building large-scale systems, proven technical leadership abilities, and a track record of delivering high-impact projects. You should excel at both hands-on technical work and strategic thinking.
shortDescription: Provide technical leadership and drive architectural decisions across the entire engineering organization.
requirements: Proven track record of technical leadership
Expert-level knowledge in multiple technical domains
